avatar-chatbot.title: Industry-Based Avatar Chatbot
avatar-chatbot.subtitle: Voice & Text AI Assistant System
avatar-chatbot.shortDescription: A web-based voice and text Avatar Chatbot that works in 4 languages and delivers industry-focused answers.
avatar-chatbot.description: A multilingual avatar chatbot trained on industry-specific knowledge bases, supporting both voice and text communication. It engages with users in real time to produce accurate, contextual answers to sector-specific questions. Built with a TensorFlow and NLTK-based NLP engine, an Angular frontend and a FastAPI backend, it delivers an enterprise-ready solution.
details: Multilingual experience supporting 4 languages (Turkish, English, German, French)
Natural language understanding and intent classification engine based on TensorFlow and NLTK
Contextual and accurate responses powered by an industry-specific knowledge base
Real-time voice interaction through a modern Angular-based web interface
High-performance, async backend infrastructure built with FastAPI and Python
Visual and immersive user experience through avatar animation integration

disaster-management.title: Earthquake Analysis & Management System
disaster-management.subtitle: Real-Time Disaster Response & Inventory Platform
disaster-management.shortDescription: An IoT-driven platform that visualizes real-time building damage status and trapped population data across Istanbul on interactive maps after an earthquake.
disaster-management.description: A comprehensive disaster response platform that monitors the structural condition of every registered building in Istanbul in real time — classifying each as standing, damaged, or collapsed — using IoT sensors installed on-site. The system maps the number of people in each building and calculates how many may be trapped under debris at any given moment. After a seismic event, it instantly generates a city-wide damage assessment and uses inventory management algorithms to produce actionable reports and resource allocation recommendations for emergency responders.
details: Real-time building damage classification (standing / damaged / collapsed) via IoT sensor data
Interactive map visualization showing per-building occupancy and debris-trapped population estimates
Live city-wide dashboard tracking the total number of people potentially under rubble in Istanbul
IoT sensor network feeding continuous structural data into the central database
Post-earthquake automated damage balance sheet covering the entire city
Inventory management algorithms generating prioritized response reports and resource recommendations
